summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Costamare Bulkers Holdings Ltd reporting Q1 2026 earnings. The filing covers profitability, liquidity, fleet renewal (one vessel acquisition, one disposal, charter-in agreements), and transfer of a trading book to Cargill. There is no special-situation event disclosed: no acquisition of another company, no divestiture of a business unit, no activist campaign, no strategic review, no tender offer, no going-private transaction, no capital return program, no spin-off (the spin-off from Costamare Inc. occurred in May 2025 and is referenced only as historical context), no rights offering, no restructuring, no liquidation, no delisting, no issuer tender, no deal termination, no SPAC merger, and no forced management change. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer and does not constitute a special situation.
